mainEntity.name: What is a crypto PR consultant and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A crypto PR consultant is a senior individual practitioner who runs your media strategy directly, rather than a managed service that routes your account through a coordinator or junior team. The consultant who takes your brief is the same person who writes the pitch, contacts the editor and follows up. This model suits Web3, DePIN, AI and cybersecurity founders who want senior access without the overhead of a full agency retainer.

mainEntity.name: How much does a crypto PR consultant cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator typically charges $5K–$12K per month for ongoing retainer work. A focused launch sprint runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks. By comparison, a traditional crypto PR agency charges $15K–$45K per month because the rate funds a multi-person account team, overhead and margin, not just the senior person working your account.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets can a crypto PR consultant realistically place?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto media: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, The Defiant. Mainstream business press where the angle justifies it: Forbes, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga. Regional: BloomingBit and TokenPost (Korea), CryptoTimes JP and CoinPost (Japan), ChainCatcher and Jinse (China), Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA). Every placement depends on a real, timely news hook, not a blanket wire distribution.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from a crypto PR consultant?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fastest results come when a consultant is engaged four to eight weeks before a specific public moment such as a raise, mainnet, listing or TGE. That window allows time for narrative positioning, journalist relationship building and embargo preparation. Cold engagement with a two-week runway is possible but constrains what is achievable. Sustained monthly retainers typically show compounding coverage by month two or three.
